description: I am a BTech Computer Science student with an interest in technology, problem-solving, AI, and space exploration. I have basic knowledge of Python, Java, SQL, and OOP concepts, and I am continuously improving my technical skills. I am excited to collaborate, learn new things, and contribute creative ideas to innovative projects. I am looking for enthusiastic, dedicated team members with skills in coding, AI/ML, web development, data analysis, and creative problem-solving.
summary: We are planning to develop an innovative and interactive game based on NASA and space exploration. Our aim is to create an engaging project that combines technology, creativity, and learning to make space science fun and accessible. We are looking for enthusiastic team members who are interested in coding, game development, UI/UX design, AI/ML, 3D modelling, research, and creative problem-solving. No matter your experience level, a willingness to learn, collaborate, and contribute ideas is what matters. Let's build something amazing together!
details: Act as an expert game developer and NASA Space Apps Challenge mentor. Help me design and develop an innovative, interactive, and educational space exploration game inspired by real NASA missions and discoveries. The game should: 1. Allow players to explore planets, moons, and the solar system. 2. Include exciting space missions, challenges, and levels. 3. Use real NASA data and scientific information wherever possible. 4. Have an attractive, modern, space-themed user interface. 5. Include interactive gameplay, scoring, rewards, and quizzes. 6. Be beginner-friendly and possible for a student team to develop
